data.desc: A10 Networks (NYSE: ATEN) delivers secure application and network solutions designed to protect, optimize, and scale business-critical systems across on-premises, hybrid cloud, and edge environments. Our portfolio is designed to enable large enterprises, service providers, and cloud platforms worldwide to achieve performance, reliability, and protection against cyber threats, while preparing their networks for the demands of AI and next-generation applications. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in San Jose, California, A10 Networks serves over 7,000 global customers. For more information, visit A10networks.com and follow us at A10Networks.
